A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the association between genetic variants and disease risk is not constant, but can be modified by other environmental factors.
n-3 fatty acid supplementation may have a beneficial effect on T2D prevention in Chinese Hans.

the PEPD variant may be a potential genetic marker for T2D risk assessment in Chinese Hans, especially in those who have lower n-3 fatty acid intake.
